<!-- pr-reviewer: aac2dbf2664b26b836e0fed432b7795d95a0ead5 -->
Needs changes before merge.

The new warning still prevents posting. It keeps the move number and the MCP `gouge` type. The decision record explains the change. No golden files changed.

Local results after a trial merge with `upstream/main` at `e2f012e90c3174fb308344e5122bb39e70531d90`:

- The merge had no conflicts.
- The test build passed. The eight selected app suites passed: `keep_law` (8), `kept_parts_live` (4), `mcp_verify` (3), `solid_law` (4), `stock_source_holes` (8), `stock_source_law` (7), `stock_source_verdict` (22), and `warned_moves` (2).
- Sim unit tests: 160 passed.
- UI tests, run from `crates/ui`: 782 unit tests passed, 5 ignored; 31 `operations` tests passed. Pixel snapshot tests were not run.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.
- The quick gate plan was read. The full quick gate was not run.

This is a safety-tier review. I repeated both reported mutations in the local worktree. For each mutation, I ran `stock_source_chamfer_refusal_names_cause_and_part_as_source_workaround` with `--exact`:

1. Remove the changes to `operation/generate.rs`: the test failed at `stock_source_holes.rs:199`. The warnings had only the generic gouge text. Restore the changes: the test passed.
2. Remove the changes to `operation/kept_rejudge.rs`: the test failed at `stock_source_holes_support/mod.rs:326`. The `chamfer-rejudge-hint` post refusal had no workaround. Restore the changes: the test passed.

All temporary changes were removed.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/app/src/operation/kept_rejudge.rs:100`: Keep the cause and the part-source instruction in the live post refusal for an operation with a frame. This call creates the new warning, but line 117 removes all warning text when `local` is present. Thus, a part added under a previously clear tilted chamfer still gets no instruction to use the part as source. Keep the cause and the instruction without an incorrect posted move number. Add a test with an operation frame. The new test turns the stock about Z; it does not exercise this branch. This is a source-code finding. The existing tests do not test this case.
2. `crates/ui/src/operations.rs:248`: Add before and after screenshots to the PR body. The change adds a separate UI warning group, but the body has no screenshots. Screenshots are required for a UI change in this review. Do not change the release snapshot PNG files.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Fixed the framed live refusal. It keeps the stock-chamfer cause and the instruction to use the part as source. It omits the local move number. `framed_stock_chamfer_live_refusal_keeps_hint_without_local_move_number` pins this. Reverting the production fix made the test RED. Restoring it made the test GREEN.

Added before and after shell-fixture screenshots to the PR body. The UI capture passed. Release snapshot PNGs are unchanged.

New head: 0d58ccca877a78908502dee6f4cdc52b39d991bc.
Quick gate: RED only on the pre-existing `winding_align::the_inside_out_stl_fixture_reads_inside_out_and_refuses` failure (line 189: `[Outward]` versus `[InsideOut]`). It reproduced identically with reviewed-head production restored. Sim, motion, UI and the nine `stock_source_holes` tests passed.
Clippy: GREEN for `camcraft-sim`, `camcraft-app` and `camcraft-ui`, all targets, warnings denied.

Please re-review this head.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 0d58ccca877a78908502dee6f4cdc52b39d991bc -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The two requests from the previous review are complete. The live post refusal for an operation with a frame keeps the cause and the instruction to use the part as source. It does not show a local move number. The PR body has before and after screenshots. I checked both images. They show the separate warning group with the new text.

The warning still prevents posting. MCP keeps the `gouge` type. Move selection keeps the warning's move index. No golden files or release snapshot PNG files changed. No dependencies, build scripts, or workflow files changed.

Local results after a trial merge with `upstream/main` at `3b1965b1fa5b67e43485a3c97b19d9413be46c54`:

- The merge had no conflicts. The working tree was clean after all mutation checks.
- The test build passed for the eight selected app suites.
- App tests passed: `keep_law` (8), `kept_parts_live` (4), `mcp_verify` (3), `solid_law` (4), `stock_source_holes` (9), `stock_source_law` (7), `stock_source_verdict` (22), and `warned_moves` (2). Total: 59 passed.
- Sim unit tests: 160 passed.
- UI tests, run from `crates/ui`: 789 unit tests passed, 5 ignored; 31 `operations` tests passed. Pixel snapshot tests were not run.
- The quick gate plan was read. The full quick gate was not run.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` failed with the errors below. The same command failed with the same errors on unchanged `upstream/main` at the SHA above. These errors are outside this PR's changes.

```text
error: constant `PNG_256` is never used
  --> crates/ui/src/egui_app/app_icon.rs:12:7
error: function `taskbar_icon` is never used
  --> crates/ui/src/egui_app/app_icon.rs:40:8
error: could not compile `camcraft-ui` (lib) due to 2 previous errors
```

The clippy command passed on the trial merge with `-D warnings -A dead-code`. This allows the inherited dead-code errors; it is not a pass with all warnings denied.

This is a safety-tier review. I repeated both reported mutations and checked the new frame fix:

1. Remove the new warning conversion from both generation arms. `stock_source_chamfer_refusal_names_cause_and_part_as_source_workaround` failed at `stock_source_holes.rs:199`. Restore the conversion: the test passed.
2. Remove the new warning conversion from the live part check. The same test failed at `stock_source_holes_support/mod.rs:326` because the post refusal had no workaround. Restore the conversion: all nine `stock_source_holes` tests passed.
3. Remove the retained guidance for an operation with a frame. `framed_stock_chamfer_live_refusal_keeps_hint_without_local_move_number` failed at `stock_source_holes.rs:273`. Restore the guidance: the test passed.

All temporary changes were removed. No requested changes remain.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
